etiquette_notes: Warmth and expressiveness are valued highly. Physical affection in public (hugging, kissing) should stay minimal on stage. Fans deeply value being addressed directly and warmly.
greeting_style: A folded-hands 'Namaste' paired with a warm smile lands well; a spoken Hindi greeting lands even better.
media_behavior_notes: Press expects some Bollywood-aware banter; journalists may ask about favorite Indian food, actors, or music. High-energy, enthusiastic tone preferred over reserved or deadpan humor.
fan_interaction_style: Fans are highly expressive — expect loud cheering, chanting, and requests for a local-language line or a dance moment. Selfie culture is intense; brief structured fan-interaction moments land better than open crowds.
dos: Learn and use 2-3 short Hindi phrases
Show high-energy enthusiasm on stage and in interviews
Reference a beloved, widely-loved local figure only with genuine care
donts: Avoid political commentary on Indian politics or religion
Avoid mocking or joking about accents
Don't compare Bollywood unfavorably to Hollywood
humor_boundaries: Self-deprecating humor lands well; humor at the expense of local culture, religion, or politics does not.

etiquette_notes: An understated, witty tone is preferred over over-the-top enthusiasm. Self-deprecating humor is highly valued. Punctuality matters more here than at many other stops.
greeting_style: A simple, warm handshake or verbal greeting; no need for elaborate gestures — sincerity reads better than performance.
media_behavior_notes: Press is sharp and can be playfully adversarial; expect witty, sometimes pointed questions. Deadpan humor and quick comebacks land well.
fan_interaction_style: Enthusiastic but more reserved than Mumbai; fans value a genuine one-on-one moment over big spectacle.
dos: Be prepared for pointed, witty press questions
donts: Don't dismiss sharp press questions defensively
humor_boundaries: Irony and understatement work well; loud, over-the-top displays can read as insincere.

etiquette_notes: Respect, humility, and precision are highly valued. Bowing is an important gesture. Fans are intensely devoted but express enthusiasm in more structured, quiet ways (synchronized chants, organized fan clubs) rather than chaotic crowd behavior.
greeting_style: A respectful bow, even a slight one, paired with a soft-spoken Japanese greeting like 'Konnichiwa' is highly appreciated.
media_behavior_notes: Press is formal and highly prepared; talent should reciprocate with humility and thank the audience explicitly and often.
fan_interaction_style: Fans are deeply devoted and highly organized; overly informal touching or spontaneity can feel jarring — structured meet-and-greet moments are preferred over improvisation.
dos: Bow when greeting press and fans
Learn a short, well-pronounced Japanese phrase
donts: Avoid overly casual physical contact with fans
Avoid interrupting or talking over interviewers
Don't rush through scheduled fan interactions
humor_boundaries: Gentle, self-aware humor is fine; sarcasm or irony often does not translate well and can confuse the tone.

etiquette_notes: A warm, high-energy, and physically expressive culture. Fans expect visible passion and excitement. Music and dance are major cultural touchpoints.
greeting_style: An enthusiastic verbal greeting in Portuguese plus open body language (waving, smiling widely) lands very well.
media_behavior_notes: Press and fans respond to visible passion and energy; a reserved or flat affect can read as disinterest.
fan_interaction_style: High-energy, participatory fan culture — chanting, singing along, and crowd call-and-response moments are highly valued.
dos: Engage in a call-and-response crowd moment if possible
donts: Avoid a reserved or low-energy demeanor
Don't confuse Brazilian Portuguese with Spanish
humor_boundaries: Playful, warm humor lands well; humor should stay warm rather than dry or ironic, which can undercut connection.

etiquette_notes: A fast-paced, direct, and confident communication style is expected. Press can be blunt and probing. Fans value authenticity and directness over polish.
greeting_style: A confident, direct greeting works best; overly formal or scripted-feeling greetings can read as inauthentic.
media_behavior_notes: Press asks direct, sometimes challenging questions; talent should engage confidently rather than deflect.
fan_interaction_style: Fans value authenticity, quick wit, and direct engagement; large, high-energy crowd moments land very well.
dos: Engage directly and confidently with press
Acknowledge the city's cultural cachet (film, music, theater) specifically
donts: Avoid scripted-sounding or overly rehearsed answers
Don't be evasive with direct questions
humor_boundaries: Quick, confident humor lands well; overly cautious or guarded responses read poorly.
